purpose: Editorial first-pass audit of the 46 Church Fathers / patristic writer profiles. It records classification, current metadata, local primary-text coverage, and issues requiring source verification. It does not claim liturgical-calendar verification where feast dates are not sourced.
rules: Distinguish Fathers, saints, Doctors, ecclesiastical writers, anonymous documents, pseudonymous works and controversial authors.
Do not publish a feast day until verified against an authoritative Catholic or relevant Eastern calendar source.
Do not treat traditional martyrdom, authorship or chronology as certain when scholarship is disputed.
A profile summary never substitutes for a verified primary text.
Modern copyrighted translations are not reproduced without permission.

profiles.major_works: First Letter of Clement to the Corinthians (1 Clement).
profiles.feast_day_policy: publish only after authoritative calendar verification

profiles.feast_day_policy: publish only after authoritative calendar verification

profiles.name: The Didache (anonymous early Church manual)

profiles.feast_day_policy: publish only after authoritative calendar verification

profiles.name: The Shepherd of Hermas

profiles.feast_day_policy: publish only after authoritative calendar verification
warnings: Work/author identity must remain distinguished; not a securely identified canonized saint.

profiles.name: St. Hippolytus of Rome

profiles.feast_day_policy: publish only after authoritative calendar verification
